text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, held at Hanshin Racecourse this 
year, it's the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Which horse girl will claim the 
prestigious Spring Shield? Keep an eye on 
BNW's Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide as 
well!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
According to the turf conditions released 
yesterday, the cushion value is also 
within normal range.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And with this weather and track 
condition... it seems fairly close to the 
Academy's Course D we ran on last week.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. Behold, my winning 
formula!
